_doc: The id module's copy of a pack's ONE first-boot walk (the User 2026-10-10): Connect, the machine-check card, Voice ID (the Register coach's routine), face photos, Your room, Your hours (the User 2026-10-11), done - landing on the listen loop. The walk itself is the player's lib/crissa_init.py, which reads config/init-sequence-pack.json; crissa_id.init_wizard's entries hand over to it, and this file names the same steps in the same order (tests/test_crissa_id_init.py holds the two equal). The house's own routine is the house's (its 13 steps never ship).

steps.title: Connect an agent
steps.body: Crissa answers through any agent that speaks the OpenAI chat-completions API: a model on this computer, a hosted API, or an agent's gateway. Fill in its address, key and model, then Test. You can also set it up later on the Connect page.

steps._doc: The machine check's permission card (the User 2026-10-10): its words come from lib/crissa_machine.card, worked out on this computer; quick = Init's check, the full one is the command line's. After the card: the voice, then the word aligner (lib/crissa_init.aligner_after_voice).

steps.title: Voice ID
steps.body: Four short recordings at this computer: the sentence on the screen and a count to six, each facing the camera and then turned away, each at its beep. Crissa learns your voice from them. They stay on this computer.
steps.body_verbal: Four short recordings at this computer, by ear: you hear a count to six, then count the same way at the beep, facing forward and then with your head turned a little to each side. Nothing to read. Your face photos are taken while you count. Crissa learns your voice from them. They stay on this computer.
steps._films: the Register coach's routine plays these (modules/id house_enroll/voice_register.py HOST_CLIPS); the walk names them so the pack ships them

steps.title: Face photos
steps.body: Look at the camera, then to the left, and Crissa takes a photo each time so she knows your face. The photos stay on this computer.
steps.no_camera: Crissa runs with no camera on this computer, so there are no face photos to take. She knows you by your voice.

steps.title: Your room
steps.body: The clock is your room seen from above: 12 is your screen and you sit facing it. Each mark starts at its default. Pick a mark, then tap its hour; change only what is different here, or skip.
steps._films: Lila's own lines (the User 2026-10-11): seats as the card opens, sound-hour when the speakers' mark is next, wave for the picture, mirrored after a No; the walk names them so the pack ships them
steps._defaults: what Crissa assumes with nothing saved: the seat facing the screen, the sound from this computer (0), the camera on top of the screen, and the door hour the presence module falls back on

wave.ask: Stand in the doorway and wave your right hand. Is that wave on the right of the picture?

one_line.say: Now label the main sound source and door location based on this diagram.
one_line.nudge: The camera in the middle is Crissa. The sound source is where media plays, like a TV or speakers, so she can filter it out. Then mark your door.

steps._one_line: the User 2026-10-14: where only the speakers and the door are asked (a fixed camera or none), Lila says `say` as the card opens and nothing per mark, the card finishes by itself after the two clicks, and `nudge` once if a mark is still unset (lib/crissa_init ROOM_ONE_LINE)

steps.title: Your hours
steps.body: Overnight is when Crissa does her own work while you are away. Quiet hours are when her announcements keep quiet. Keep the defaults, change them, or skip.
steps._films: Lila's own lines (the User 2026-10-11), said in turn as the card opens; the walk names them so the pack ships them
